name: Banana Climbers
summary:
Wow, Gorilla Tag fan games are really getting boring these days! I wish there was a game where you could fool around, become a fruit, become…….. BANANA! Welcome to Banana Climbers, a fun and safe game throughout all of VR! What can you do in this game you may ask? Well let me show you!

We’ve got zero gravity! A place where gravity doesn’t exist, and a place to flow around like bubbles.

Hyper! Run around like a craaaaaaaazy banana, and juke other players. Break their ankle and chop it up for breakfast.
